query: How does JPMorgan determine the estimated value of the notes?
query_paraphrase: What methodology does the bank use to come up with its own fair value for this product?
query_rewritten: estimated value of the notes determined by JPMS using internal pricing models and internal funding rate

query: Why is the original issue price higher than the estimated value of the notes?
query_paraphrase: Where does the gap between the $1,000 I pay and what the note is worth go?
query_rewritten: estimated value is less than the original issue price; difference due to selling commissions, projected hedging profits, and estimated hedging costs

query: What internal funding rate is used to value the notes?
query_ko: 노트 가치 평가에 쓰는 내부 조달금리는?
query_paraphrase: What borrowing cost assumption does JPMorgan apply when pricing its own debt in these products?
query_rewritten: internal funding rate used to determine estimated value, lower than the rate at which JPMorgan Chase & Co. borrows through conventional fixed rate debt

query: Whose credit risk does a noteholder bear?
relevant_phrases: credit risk of JPMorgan Chase & Co
query_paraphrase: If JPMorgan went bankrupt, would I lose my money?
query_rewritten: notes are unsecured obligations; payments subject to credit risk of JPMorgan Chase & Co.; you may lose your entire investment if it defaults

query: What happens to the contingent interest payment if the underlying closes below the interest barrier?
query_ko: 기초자산이 쿠폰 배리어 아래면 조건부 쿠폰은 어떻게 되나?
relevant_phrases: no Contingent Interest Payment will be made
query_paraphrase: Do I still get paid my coupon in a month when the index is down a lot?
query_rewritten: contingent interest payment made only if closing level on review date is greater than or equal to interest barrier; otherwise no interest

query: Can the issuer redeem the notes early at its own election?
query_paraphrase: Can JPMorgan decide to pay me back before maturity whenever it wants?
query_rewritten: issuer's call right: we may redeem the notes early at our election on any call date for the principal amount plus coupon

query: How does the 6.0% per annum daily deduction affect the index level?
query_ko: 연 6% 일일 차감은 지수 수준에 어떤 영향을 주나?
query_paraphrase: Why does this volatility-targeting index tend to lag the underlying futures over time?
query_rewritten: excess return strategy volatility target index embedded fees, synthetic financing costs and futures roll can cause the index to underperform the underlying

query: What potential conflicts of interest exist between JPMorgan and investors?
query_paraphrase: Does JPMorgan make money in ways that could hurt me as an investor in this note?
query_rewritten: potential conflicts of interest: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and its affiliates hedging activities and other trading may adversely affect the value of the notes

query: Will there be an active secondary market for the notes?
query_paraphrase: Will I be able to sell this note easily before it matures?
query_rewritten: secondary market: JPMS may make a market but is not obligated; lack of liquidity; notes may not be able to be sold prior to maturity

query: Is the return on the notes capped at a maximum return?
query_paraphrase: Is there a ceiling on how much I can earn if the market rallies?
query_rewritten: your maximum return is limited by the maximum return or cap; you will not participate in appreciation above the cap

query: How is the upside leverage factor applied to a positive underlying return?
query_paraphrase: If the index goes up 10%, how much more than that do I get?
query_rewritten: upside leverage factor: payment at maturity equals principal amount plus principal times upside leverage factor times index return if final value exceeds initial value

query: What reinvestment risk arises if the notes are automatically called?
query_paraphrase: If my note gets called early, will I find a similar investment at the same yield?
query_rewritten: reinvestment risk: if the notes are automatically called early, you may be unable to reinvest proceeds in a comparable investment with similar yield

query: Are missed contingent interest payments paid later if the barrier is met again?
query_ko: 놓친 쿠폰을 나중에 받을 수 있나(메모리)?
query_paraphrase: If I miss a coupon this quarter, can I catch it up later?
query_rewritten: contingent interest payments not cumulative; if interest is not payable on a review date, no make-up or later payment of missed interest

query: How is the call premium determined if the notes are called on a review date?
query_ko: 조기상환 시 상환 프리미엄은 어떻게 정해지나?
query_paraphrase: How much extra do I get on top of principal if the note is redeemed on an observation date?
query_rewritten: automatic call: if closing level on any call observation date is greater than or equal to the call threshold, pays principal amount plus call premium amount

query: How does a dual directional note pay when the underlying declines?
query_ko: 듀얼 디렉셔널 노트는 하락 시 어떻게 지급하나?
query_paraphrase: Can I make money on this note even if stocks go down?
query_rewritten: digital return if final value is greater than or equal to the downside threshold; positive return even if underlying declines; buffer amount

query: What is the digital return and when is it paid?
query_paraphrase: Is there a fixed payout if the underlying ends flat or higher?
query_rewritten: digital payment at maturity: if final value is greater than or equal to initial value, you will receive the fixed digital return

query: What is the step barrier in trigger step securities?
query_paraphrase: What level must the underlying stay above to get the minimum fixed return at maturity?
query_rewritten: if the final value is greater than or equal to the trigger value or barrier, payment at maturity equals principal amount plus fixed contingent return

query: What is the downside threshold and what happens below it at maturity?
query_ko: 다운사이드 임계값 아래로 떨어지면 만기에 어떻게 되나?
query_paraphrase: Below what level do I start losing principal one-for-one at maturity?
query_rewritten: if final value is less than the buffer threshold or trigger level, you will lose 1% of principal for every 1% decline beyond the buffer

query: What happens if a market disruption event occurs on a review date?
query_paraphrase: What if the exchange is closed or trading is halted on an observation day?
query_rewritten: market disruption event; if a valuation or observation date is not a trading day or trading is suspended, determination postponed to next scheduled trading day

query: What is the U.S. federal income tax treatment of the notes?
query_paraphrase: How will the IRS treat income from this note?
query_rewritten: tax treatment: U.S. federal income tax consequences; notes treated as prepaid forward or pre-paid derivative contracts; contingent payment debt instrument; Section 1260

query: Product-specific: what are the Interest Barrier and Trigger Value?
query_ko: 이 상품의 쿠폰 배리어와 트리거 값은?

query: Product-specific: what are the Buffer Amount and Upside Leverage Factor?
Product-specific: what is the Contingent Interest Rate?
Product-specific: what is the maximum return?
